# ankra_deploy_environments (Data Source)

Lists the deploy environments of the provider's project: the environments host targets register into and deploy stages name. An environment is created by the first `ankra_host_join_token` minted for it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_deploy_environments" "all" {}

output "environment_names" {
  value = data.ankra_deploy_environments.all.environments[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) Deploy environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `truncated` (Boolean) Whether the platform stopped the listing at its row cap.
